ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi Syslog Configuration Change Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the ESXi syslog configuration via "esxcli"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*system.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*syslog.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ set.*"))
